ABOUT US

A Taste of Tradition.
A Touch of Modern Elegance.

At Saffron & Crumbs, we believe desserts should be more than beautiful. They should tell a story.

Inspired by the flavours of Indian sweets and the elegance of modern patisserie, we reimagine familiar favourites as thoughtfully crafted cakes and desserts, bringing together tradition, creativity, and a little indulgence.

Thoughtfully crafted. Beautifully yours.

Born from the bond between a mother in Toronto and a daughter in San Francisco, Saffron & Crumbs brings two perspectives and one shared love of creating something special. Though miles apart, we're connected by family traditions, creativity, and the joy of bringing people together.

From carefully chosen flavours and elegant finishing touches to peanut-free creations and eggless options, every detail is considered with care.

More than dessert. A reason to celebrate.

Our hope is simple: to make every occasion, big or small, a little sweeter.
